name: Box0 Voice Link
description: Bridges BOX0 wireless-mic buttons to desktop hotkeys: M tap toggles WeChat voice input (Ctrl+Win+Shift), M hold = hold-to-talk (Left Alt+Left Win), RIGHT sends Enter, LEFT sends Backspace.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 将 BOX0 无线麦按键映射为桌面快捷键：M 短按开始/停止微信语音输入（Ctrl+Win+Shift），M 长按按住说话（左Alt+左Win），右键发送 Enter，左键发送 Backspace。
descriptionI18n.en: Bridges BOX0 wireless-mic buttons to desktop hotkeys: M tap toggles WeChat voice input (Ctrl+Win+Shift), M hold = hold-to-talk (Left Alt+Left Win), RIGHT sends Enter, LEFT sends Backspace.

author: box0
